items.stem: How does an AI mostly get better at a task?

options.A: A person rewrites its answers by hand each morning
options.B: It waits for perfect rules typed in legal language
options.C: It finds patterns in many examples during a practice phase

items.stem: After practice, the AI faces a brand-new email. What is it doing?

options.A: Applying patterns it learned to a case it has not seen
options.B: Opening a private folder of every email ever written
options.C: Asking a random coworker to vote

items.stem: Which everyday picture best matches AI learning?

options.A: A calculator that only adds numbers you type
options.B: A cook who tastes many dishes and then invents a similar one
options.C: A locked safe that never changes

items.stem: Why do varied examples help more than identical ones?

options.A: Variety confuses the AI on purpose
options.B: Identical examples make the AI funnier
options.C: Variety shows which patterns still work in new situations

items.stem: "The know-how the AI has learned from examples" is another way to say:

options.A: The patterns and dials it tuned during practice
options.B: The brand logo on the chat window
options.C: The length of the power cable

items.stem: An AI practiced only on sunny beach photos. It fails on snowy streets. Why?

options.B: The patterns it learned do not cover this new setting
options.C: It refuses outdoor pictures on principle

items.stem: What is a fair description of pattern learning?

options.A: Guaranteed truth on every future case
options.B: Memorizing one example and ignoring the rest
options.C: Noticing what repeats across examples and reusing it

items.stem: A teacher marks 500 essays as strong or weak. An AI studies them. What did it gain?

options.A: A sense of which features often appear in strong writing
options.B: The legal right to grade every school forever
options.C: A copy of each student's home address

options.A: Once practiced, an AI never meets a surprising case
options.B: Practice builds useful patterns, but new cases can still break them
options.C: Patterns replace the need for any human judgment
